data.title: 伽玛 · 办公桌上的恩赏
data.description: 深夜来访的暗影没有敲门。他站在办公桌后，指尖勾开露娜礼服的后拉链，只说了一句“继续算”。伽玛扶着账本伏在桌沿，礼服堆在腰间，随着身后的律动一页页算错了数字。金币也好、银行也好——她替他打下的整座江山，都不如这一刻伏在桌上的自己更让他满意。「错、错了也……没有关系……暗影大人……」
data.location: 四越商会会长办公室·深夜
data.action: 伏在办公桌沿，礼服褪至腰间，被从身后进入，手扶账本
data.lighting: single desk lamp in the dark office, gold coins glinting
data.promptProse: Shadow visits without knocking. Adult Gamma bends over her own president desk, gown pooled at her waist, gripping the ledgers as he takes her from behind in the lamplight — still trying, and failing, to keep count.
data.animaCaption: He tells her to keep counting. For the first time in her life, Gamma gets every number wrong — gladly.
